Modal-state DOM sync for AppRoot — toggles modal-open on html/body and copies the modifier class onto the wrapper. Scroll lock is native: the expand <dialog> runs showModal() so the document is inert behind the top layer — no fixed-position pin, no scroll shift, nothing to restore on close.
